text: hey everybody been a minute but I'm in the Israel Museum and I wanted to share one of my favorite sets of artifacts in the world these are the large and small
incense altars and the standing stones from the Judah height Temple that was discovered at a rod some interesting
things to note here the large standing Stone was found laid on its side and buried under six feet of Earth the other
standing Stone was found incorporated into the architecture of the wall we also have small and large incense altars
with some substances on top that were tested and the smaller incense alter the substances on there were shown to have a
few different types of cannabis that were being burned anciently this Temple was decommissioned and was buried around
700 BCE some Scholars think this was a part of hezekiah's reforms but oddly enough these Standing Stones were not
destroyed or broken which is what usually happens when something is being destroyed another theory is that this was being
hidden in order to protect this sacred Precinct from the coming invasion of the Assyrian King sinachary
